note: Frozen before test-4 is annotated and before any system runs on it. Committed and pushed first; totals are published whatever they are. Per-record outputs are never read.
background: On test-3 (Codex-annotated, old guide) hybrid-1 had 53 ready regions, 7 correct (13%). A Claude review of 23 disputed rows under the guide's new absent-place rule (GBIF Georeferencing Best Practices 3.2.2) estimated about 46% (approx. 36-57%), and suggested the remaining errors mostly come from labels naming a place that is in GNIS while the system uses the offset's town. That estimate was made after the result was seen, by an annotator who wrote the systems. test-4 checks it on unread labels.

questions.primary: Under the absent-place rule, do most of hybrid-1's wrong ready regions come from choosing another place when the annotated place is in GNIS?
secondary: What share of hybrid-1's ready regions are correct under the absent-place rule?
Does selection-2 pass the same rule it failed on test-3?

systems.without_check: hybrid-1 (rules-6 first, llm-x2g2-qwen3.5-4b-q4km where the rules reach no candidate), reviewed + derived extents

inputs.draw: benchmark draw-extra --name test-4 --seed benchmark-4/1 --size 120 --prefix Q --shape place_offset --shape-version 2 --repeats 0 --exclude-lock eval/splits-2.lock.json --exclude-lock eval/splits-3.lock.json --lock-out eval/splits-4.lock.json (EXTRA_VERSION 1)

annotations.procedure: The owner fills eval/benchmark/test-4/worksheet.csv from eval/annotation_guide.md at the pinned hash (including the absent-place rule) and the pinned GNIS snapshot, without opening system outputs. The owner's first commit of the worksheet after this declaration counts; it must pass the checker with 0 errors, and fixes go in a recorded further commit before any run.
annotations.if_someone_else_annotates: An amendment naming the annotator is pushed before any run, and every result is labelled with that annotator. Claude-annotated results would not be independent of the systems.

how_it_runs: Outputs go to the locked folder eval/benchmark/test-4/reports/. Standard output goes to log files there. LLM cache off, native llama-server.
Common run options: --sample eval/benchmark/test-4/test-4.json --extents data/reviewed/extents.csv --derived-extents data/extents/derived.csv --out eval/benchmark/test-4/reports.

Without the check: `audit rules`; `audit llm --no-cache`; `audit hybrid --sample eval/benchmark/test-4/test-4.json --out eval/benchmark/test-4/reports --with-derived`; `audit score --sample eval/benchmark/test-4/test-4.json --out eval/benchmark/test-4/reports --worksheet eval/benchmark/test-4/worksheet.csv --with-derived --hybrid <out>/test-4-hybrid-1-extents-derived.json` (audit score takes no extent-store options).
With the check: the same with --selection-2 on rules and llm, and --with-derived --with-selection-2 on hybrid and score (hybrid report test-4-hybrid-1-extents-derived-sel2.json).

Stages: `uv run python scripts/diagnose_regions.py eval/benchmark/test-4/test-4.json eval/benchmark/test-4/worksheet.csv <hybrid report> <score report> eval/benchmark/test-4/diagnosis/dispute-candidates.txt`, without and with the check (counts only).

primary.supported: Among hybrid-1's wrong ready regions without the check, the stage 'clause choice (other place chosen)' (annotated place in GNIS) is the largest stage AND covers at least half of them.
primary.not_supported: Anything else, including no wrong ready regions.
primary.computed_from: scripts/diagnose_regions.py stage counts for the hybrid report without the check

selection_2.works: Among the regions selection-2 holds back, wrong ones are at least twice the correct ones, AND the share of ready regions that are correct rises by at least 5 percentage points (the test-3 rule, unchanged).
selection_2.computed_from: the two hybrid score reports' totals: held back correct = correct ready regions without the check minus with it; held back wrong = wrong ready regions without minus with

expectation_stated_in_advance.precision_without_check: about 46%, plausible range 36-57% (the test-3 review estimate); reported against this range, not a decision
expectation_stated_in_advance.primary: supported, on the test-3 review's reading; but that came from 10 rows judged by Claude
expectation_stated_in_advance.selection_2: likely does not work: under the absent-place rule an offset region is often correct when the named place is absent from GNIS, and selection-2 holds exactly those back

secondary_reported: ready regions, correct, useful coverage for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, with and without the check
correct proposal candidates for rules, LLM and hybrid-1, and hybrid minus rules (paired bootstrap, sign test)
category counts, and how many rows use the absent-place rule (absent-specific in notes)
caveats: The absent-place rule was adopted after test-3's result was seen.
The systems, the rule's wording and the stage script were written by Claude, on dev data and on test-3 diagnosis.
test-4 holds only one label shape (place, offset).
One annotator; the stage split depends on that annotator's clause choices and GNIS lookups.
run_rules: Each run happens once. A technical failure may be rerun under this declaration and is recorded.
Only totals are published, in eval/reports/test-4.{md,json}.
